messages:
Alex R: Heads up — found a compat hiccup in v2 SDK RC2 when toggling the feature_flag:backend_v2 in staging.
Maya S: Oh no, what behavior are you seeing?
Alex R: Responses come back as 200 but body is old schema (has 'result' instead of 'choices'). Looks like the routing layer forwarded to v1 shim.
Chris L: That sounds like the routing policy mismatch we saw last week. Which config set did staging pick?
Alex R: staging-picked: service-routing=v2-primary, fallback=v1-shim. But the request header x-api-version was missing in the SDK call.
Sam (SDK): We added auto-version header only in RC3, RC2 still relies on client to set X-Redwood-API-Version. Could be the root cause.
Maya S: Can you paste the exact curl or code snippet that reproduces?
Alex R: Repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":20}'
```
No X-Redwood-API-Version header.
Sam (SDK): Yep that will hit old routing because routing uses header override before path. We should either enforce header or make routing fallback smarter.
Chris L: Quick question — is this only when feature_flag:backend_v2=true?
Alex R: It's intermittent — when the flag is on, some requests still get routed to the shim if header missing. Suspect a cache key mismatch in the router.
DevOps Bot: Canary deploy (staging->canary) completed for routing-service v2.1.1 in us-west-2 — 3/3 healthy.
Maya S: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) add a server-side soft-override: treat requests without version header as v2 for feature_flag customers, 2) patch RC2 test harness to set header.
Sam (SDK): We can push a small RC2 hotfix to inject header in outgoing clients for flagged orgs. Low risk.
Chris L: Ownership? Alex can you own a minimal router tweak + smoke? Sam can own SDK patch. Maya will coordinate rollout.
Alex R: I can do router tweak and smoke in staging today, then promote to canary.
Sam (SDK): I’ll open a small RC2 PR to add X-Redwood-API-Version for flagged tenants and run unit + integration tests.
Maya S: Timeline: aim to have both PRs ready in 3 hours, smoke in staging in 4h, canary by EOD if green.
Chris L: Also add a quick e2e test asserting response schema for both header/no-header cases.
Sam (SDK): Will add test in sdk/integration/v2_smoke_test.py.
Alex R: After canary, we should update the migration checklist to require header presence or server fallback documented.
Maya S: Thanks—please drop PR links here when ready. @Sam (SDK) @Alex R :thumbsup:
Sam (SDK): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/1284 (WIP)
Alex R: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/pulls/512 (WIP)
Maya S: Great. If anything flakey comes up, ping me and I’ll pause canary.
Chris L: One more ask — add a short blurb for the SDK changelog noting RC2->RC3 header behavior so customers don't get surprised.
Sam (SDK): Will do.
Alex R: Thanks everyone, starting work now.
Maya S: copying this into the migration board card for visibility.
